verdict.rationale: Workflow contracts can be saved as YAML (yylo-docs-4) and the CLI/ledger source is fully open-source under MIT (yylo-probe-rt-2), suggesting no vendor lock-in, but there is no documented single 'export all data' command covering ledger records, task history, sessions, and artifacts in open formats. Missing for 10: an explicit data-export command/feature, documentation of export formats for ledger/kanban/session data, and confirmation that all state (not just workflow YAML) is portable.
